study.question: After relevance scorers become private, should click and category/brand auxiliary tasks all update shared embeddings through the relevance-score branch?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g3-r0003-private_relevance reaches macro AUC 0.8120988584 versus baseline-din 0.8099233881, but macro Logloss worsens to 0.0567131826 versus 0.0566229514. Gains concentrate in longer histories; empty/short-history macro AUC is lower than baseline. The private/uniform comparison is single-seed and also changes effective capacity. Feedback-group routing and peer transfer did not beat their entry model. Provisional mechanism: private scorers still feed their different relevance gradients into the same shared embeddings, alongside value/readout gradients. Impression-click versus 24h category/brand auxiliary labels may create incompatible relevance updates. Stopping auxiliary score-input gradients may preserve complementary value learning while improving the AUC/logloss tradeoff. Gradient conflict has not been directly observed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version v4 primary text lines 250-277 inspected: inherit target-dependent unnormalized local-activation pooling through the local adaptation; change only task-specific backward connectivity. This is not a new activation formula or exact original DIN reproduction.

Local source SHA256 a97059fb802a4d4208ec217e10aa1716be16bab7000f0088e44b938c317c1851 matched the starting candidate. Preserve parameters/forward paths and add label-based detach switches at scorer inputs.

Pinned benchmark source lines 204-308 and benchmark section 2.3 inspected: task/shared hubs aggregate and broadcast forward information. Here there are no hubs/broadcasts, only branch-specific embedding updates. Original detailed paper text unavailable; original-method equivalence and priority unverified.

inherited_components: Parent shared FeatureEmbeddingDict and actual feature-map field/source selection
Parent masked history item/action inputs, target interactions, four cloned-initialized Dice relevance trunks, score outputs and unnormalized value pooling
Parent separate Dice prediction towers and reset/equalization/RNG order
Host four-task API and sum of four unweighted BCEs; no optimizer or training-loss hook change
study.proposed_difference: Only detach the flattened target/history/action interaction tensor before selected private relevance trunks. Independently block click and auxiliary scorer-input gradients in a 2x2 factorial. Scorer parameters still learn from their task losses; values and direct context/target readouts stay attached. No extra trainable parameters, observations, forward mixing or task inputs. All standalone sources differ only in boolean defaults/CONFIG. Broad gradient-routing nearest work remains unverified: the authorized registry search yielded no detailed matching source. No novelty claim.
predictions: Primary prediction: aux_score_stop improves validation macro AUC and lowers macro Logloss versus all_score_live. These are scientific predictions, not replacement selection thresholds. Select with frozen macro-AUC/tie-breaker rule.
Asymmetry prediction: aux_score_stop outperforms click_score_stop; if only all_score_stop improves, generic score/value learning decoupling better explains it.

Same state/batch yields identical initial predictions, Dice buffer updates and RNG consumption across cells and parent. Only selected scorer-input gradient paths vanish; all relevance parameters/value/readout paths remain trainable.
Expected parameter count is parent 32144072 for the same feature map. Inference arithmetic is identical; actual backward/training time and memory may differ and must be measured.

Use existing empty, 1-16, 17-64 and >64 history bins for exploratory diagnostics, reporting sample/positive/negative counts. Empty-history purchase has only 13 positives; do not infer reliability from this slice or significance from one seed.
falsifiers: aux_score_stop does not improve fixed macro AUC against all_score_live in paired repetitions; per-task regressions may reduce the equal-weight mean.
click_score_stop matches/exceeds aux_score_stop, weakening click/aux asymmetry; all_score_stop matching both single-stop effects favors generic learning changes.
Initial forward/parameter/buffer/RNG parity fails, blocked scorer-input paths retain gradients, or scorer parameters stop learning: implementation contrast invalid.
A later gradient-magnitude-matched control erases any gain, supporting scale/regularization rather than conflicting gradient directions. This follow-up has not run.
alternative_explanations: Stopping a gradient path changes gradient magnitudes and Adagrad accumulators; benefit alone does not prove conflicting directions
Auxiliary factor bundles cart/fav/buy; it does not identify individual donor effects
Shared value and direct-readout gradient paths remain; this does not remove all cross-task transfer
Initial comparison uses one seed, with validation search and inherited Dice/padding effects
Ranking/calibration tradeoff or one-pass regularization rather than harmful cross-task information
Shared target/value learning can change empty-history predictions even with no history-scoring contribution

host_checks: Before training, host checks actual frozen feature map, four finite [B,1] outputs, finite sum-BCE/backward and FP32/frozen-BF16 compatibility.

Same seed: compare parent and all cells parameter names/shapes/values, distinct private trunk and Dice buffer storage, RNG state, initial train/eval outputs and buffer updates. FP32 atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-5; BF16 atol=2e-3 rtol=1e-2. All-live must also match parent per-parameter gradients and one host optimizer step.

Check empty/full/short/holey/zero-length histories. Perturb masked historical IDs/actions and target action; predictions and valid-input gradients invariant. Preserve inherited padded-query contribution to Dice statistics.

Isolate _pool using independent differentiable target/keys/actions/values leaves and valid nonempty history. Backprop one task pooled summary: selected target/keys/actions scorer gradients absent/zero, live paths finite and nonzero under nondegenerate weights/inputs; every task scorer-parameter and independent-value gradients remain. Separately check actual forward direct target/context readout gradients. Value/direct paths must not be confused with a failed scorer stop.
Permute feature_map.labels: click/aux switches must follow label strings. No current labels enter forward; masks and history visibility unchanged.

All-live validation replay should match g3-r0003-private_relevance within observed host reproducibility. Resolve mismatch before intervention attribution; retain all costs. Archived candidate_diagnostics was not_requested, so no past runtime-check pass is assumed.

trajectory_interpretation: Round 0 task/action scorer 0.8114567736 exceeded shared/action 0.8111539425, while both item-only variants were lower (0.8071249583, 0.8068573953). This supports preserving historical-action inputs for the next controlled experiment, provisionally.
Round 1 feedback-context/support/reversed-mask factorial (0.8102586597 to 0.8105780168) did not beat its 0.8114567736 entry; do not infer every feedback-group mechanism is ineffective.

Round 2 peer/self and detached/joint residual transfer (0.8112515518 to 0.8114146034) did not beat the same entry; the new study detaches scorer inputs, not donor activations, so these results are not equivalent controls.

Round 3 private/partial/uniform scorer states scored 0.8120988584/0.8117084622/0.8113736080. Uniform mixing is symmetry-collapsed and not an equal effective-capacity control. Four-trunk compute and parameter shapes were matched; private gain still does not identify embedding conflict.
Round 3 incumbent replay exactly matched round 0 task/action macro AUC; this is observed reproducibility for that model only, not independent seed or mechanism support.
